title: Online backups: 3 per campaign, and easy downloads
summary: Each account now keeps up to 3 online backups per campaign, and Lootsplitter makes it easy to keep a downloaded copy of your campaigns.
items: Online backups are limited to 3 per campaign. When a campaign already has 3, My account → Backups tells you which backup your next save replaces, with Download it first, and asks before replacing it.
Only the oldest backup of that campaign is replaced, and only after the new one is completely saved. Your other campaigns' backups are never touched.
Backups you already have are kept: nothing is removed automatically, and each new save replaces at most one older backup.
Deleting a shared campaign no longer fails just because its recovery copy needs space: it replaces that campaign's oldest online backup in the same way, after offering to download the campaign first.

Download a copy is now a main button in Backups, every online backup has a labelled Download button, and each shared campaign you run has Download a copy in Campaigns. Settings → Device backups → Import reads these files.
Backups shows when this device last downloaded the open campaign, as a gentle reminder to keep a fresh local copy.
